# Lugh

> Lugh is an open-source programming language for AI agents. Programs declare which systems an agent may touch (`use`), its limits (`budget`), and which actions need human approval (`policy`). Every action is typed as read, write, send, spend, delete, submit or execute, and is checked by the runtime before it happens. The core runtime is written in Rust; there is also a Python reference runtime and a WebAssembly build for the browser.

Use Lugh when an agent's actions must be reviewable before they run: a person can read a program's policy block and its `--check` report and know exactly what it can do. `lugh plan "<goal>"` has a model write a Lugh program, compiles it, shows what it can touch, and runs it with only reads allowed without asking.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Ashutosh3142857/lugh-lang/blob/main/README.md): overview, quick start, benchmarks
- [Language specification](https://github.com/Ashutosh3142857/lugh-lang/blob/main/docs/SPEC.md): syntax, statements, expressions, effects, web routes and pages
- [Standard library](https://github.com/Ashutosh3142857/lugh-lang/blob/main/docs/STDLIB.md): every function, mapped to Python and JavaScript equivalents
- [MCP and lugh plan](https://github.com/Ashutosh3142857/lugh-lang/blob/main/docs/MCP.md): connecting to MCP servers; model-written programs with human approval

## Try a program

- [Playground](https://ashutosh3142857.github.io/lugh-lang/): runs in the browser; adapters (fs, http, mcp, shell) act on a simulated world, behind the real policy gate. Open a program with `#code=<base64url>` and add `?run=1` to run it on load.
- Check a program without installing: `npx lugh-lang run program.lugh` (also `test`, `check`, `sandbox`; `--decline` answers approvals with no). Exits 1 if a goal or test fails.
- Guard an existing MCP server: `npx -y lugh-lang guard --policy <file|filesystem|github|supabase|stripe> -- <server command>` puts allow/ask/deny, budgets and an audit log in front of any stdio MCP server. See [docs/GUARD.md](https://github.com/Ashutosh3142857/lugh-lang/blob/main/docs/GUARD.md).
- MCP server: `npx -y lugh-lang mcp` (registry name `io.github.Ashutosh3142857/lugh`). Tools: `lugh_reference`, `lugh_check`, `lugh_run`, `lugh_test`, `lugh_sandbox`; all read-only, programs run in the sandbox. See [npm/README.md](https://github.com/Ashutosh3142857/lugh-lang/blob/main/npm/README.md).

## Examples

- [stdlib_test.lugh](https://github.com/Ashutosh3142857/lugh-lang/blob/main/examples/stdlib_test.lugh): the standard library, as tests
- [notes_agent.lugh](https://github.com/Ashutosh3142857/lugh-lang/blob/main/examples/notes_agent.lugh): an agent using an MCP server under a policy
- [fare_desk.lugh](https://github.com/Ashutosh3142857/lugh-lang/blob/main/examples/fare_desk.lugh): a web app with an approvals inbox
- [ledger.lugh](https://github.com/Ashutosh3142857/lugh-lang/blob/main/examples/ledger.lugh): SQLite, validation, auth, scheduled jobs
